RegisterDevice.summary: Device-side SDK registration and authorization service.

schema.description: Required appKey for device-side SDK authorization: after the User logs on to the SDK Authorization Center customer platform with an Alibaba Cloud account and assigns or creates a new batch of issued authorizations, this appKey is obtained.

Required SDKCode for device-side SDK authorization: each issued SDK authorization has a unique SDKCode, which can be obtained from the authorization list after logging on to the SDK Authorization Center customer platform.
Required DeviceId for device-side SDK authorization: the UUID of the device, generated during device-side integration, which must be unique and immutable.

The ID information provided by the user, which serves as a UUID for authorized devices to facilitate User Management and record keeping, and can later be used to troubleshoot authorization issues on the user side.
Additional extension information in JSON structure, facilitating future parameter extensions.

Message.description: Indicates whether the authorization API call succeeded.

ErrorMessage.description: The result of the authorization API call.

RequestId.description: The RequestId of the authorization request.

ErrorCode.description: The error code indicating whether the authorization API call succeeded or failed.

Data.description: Data returned by the device-side authorization.

License.description: The encrypted authorization information issued by the cloud.

Signature.description: The signature result of the authorization information issued by the cloud.

PublicKey.description: Public key information corresponding to the Customer Account.

Rid.description: The UUID for each authorization record of the User's device-side SDK.
